summary: Chat now scrolls across the full window, with its scrollbar at the far right while messages remain centered and readable.
instructions: Open Chat and scroll a long conversation. The scrolling area spans the screen instead of stopping at the narrow message column; the composer stays at the bottom. Desktop and mobile widths (1905, 1024, 390 and 320 pixels), independent scrolling, draft preservation, and approval-warning layout were browser-tested. All 166 Python tests and the self-test passed in the project runtime. Existing draft protection and automatic version updates are unchanged.
